    int x;
    scanf("%d", &x);
    return x;

int main() {
    long long n = nextInt();
    long long m = nextInt();

    if (n > m) {
        std::swap(n, m);
    }

    long long answer;

    if (n == 1) {
        long long penalty[] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1};
        answer = n * m - penalty[m % 6];
    } else if (n == 2) {
        if (m == 2) {
            answer = n * m - 4;
        } else if (m == 3 || m == 7) {
            answer = n * m - 2;
        } else {
            answer = n * m;
        }
    } else if (n == 3) {
        answer = n * m - (m & 1LL);
    } else {
        answer = n * m - ((n & 1LL) & (m & 1LL));
    }

    printf("%lld\n", answer);
    return 0;
}
